chunks.text: APR includes some lender fees spread over the loan; compare APR and also separate closing costs when evaluating breakeven.
Breakeven months estimate how long lower monthly payments take to recover upfront points and fees. It ignores time value of money unless you model a discount rate.
Total cost over a chosen horizon (for example 5 years) helps if you may sell or refinance again before the loan matures.
House age and purchase date inform maintenance risk and equity seasoning, but the mathematical comparison is driven mainly by balance, rate, term, and fees.
This tool is educational and uses demo lender data. It is not a loan commitment or personalized financial advice.
